Why partner with me

A real life.
A relatable
point of view.

I know the everyday. I work a full-time corporate job and commute to an office. I create from the same busy, ordinary life that many people in my community recognise.

Italy is part of the story. Based in northern Italy, between the Dolomites and Lake Garda, I bring a personal perspective to the places and experiences around me.

I’ve started over, too. From Latvia to Toronto to Italy, living across countries has shaped how I see the world — and the stories I want to tell.

Thoughtful content, rooted in a life actually lived.
